body.objective: Publish a reviewable canonical source candidate linked to the exact deployed artifact without autonomously merging it.
acceptance_criteria: Candidate branch records commit, image digest, full tests, rollback and deployment identity
Canonical promotion remains REVIEW_REQUIRED until independent human approval
constraints: do not modify the user's in-progress rebase
do not merge or promote without human approval
falsification_tests: A clean checkout cannot reproduce the recorded tests or artifact identity

body.objective: Prove WorldLab outcome ingestion, replicated assessment, inert goal projection and interaction lineage as one fail-closed chain.
acceptance_criteria: Thirty replicated events create one assessment and one inert goal
Every event and goal is visible with experiment, trajectory, finding and evidence lineage
constraints: reuse external event ingestion and OutcomeLearningService
no causal claim from exploratory evidence
falsification_tests: Exploratory or correlated evidence becomes promotion eligible

body.objective: Project each deduplicated curiosity gap into a bounded preregistered research work item that an existing research loop can execute.
acceptance_criteria: The projection contains question, hypothesis, null hypothesis, variables, controls, confounders, randomization, replication count, stopping condition, falsification and limitations
Repeated scans do not duplicate active research work
constraints: network and side effects denied by default
projection alone is not research evidence
falsification_tests: A gap can be marked resolved without evidence or a falsifiable protocol

body.objective: Require exact candidate, capability, model, runtime and skill attribution plus causal support before outcome evidence can support evolution.
acceptance_criteria: Correlated and exploratory signals remain UNDETERMINED
Duplicate replications do not increase n
Falsified causal evidence contains the capability
constraints: no promotion eligibility from this service
falsification_tests: Missing attribution or duplicate seeds produce SUPPORTED assurance

body.objective: Route checker work using the seven-dimensional independence vector and block unknown or correlated high-risk review assignments.
acceptance_criteria: Checker lease records all seven identity dimensions
High-risk assignment is blocked when independence is FAIL or UNDETERMINED
Different agent IDs alone never yield PASS
constraints: manual checker remains possible but UNDETERMINED until identity evidence exists
falsification_tests: Same model, prompt, context or memory is accepted as independent

body.objective: Attach a replayable success or deliberate-denial trace to every declared ecosystem contract and expose missing traffic as UNDETERMINED.
acceptance_criteria: Every declared contract has a stable contract identifier and evidence state
Observed traces include correlation, actor, target, action, scope, status and evidence
Missing observations remain UNDETERMINED
constraints: keep declared contracts separate from observed traffic
falsification_tests: A declared but unobserved contract is shown as PASS

body.objective: Provide four typed, audited evidence actions on the Interaction Board without direct execution authority.
acceptance_criteria: Users can request evidence, challenge a claim, request reproduction or start a bounded experiment
Every action records actor, target, correlation, reason and evidence references
Actions project only into existing governed records
constraints: no implicit promotion or goal completion
falsification_tests: A board action causes an external side effect or bypasses DjimitFlo policy

body.objective: Derive agent specialization only from attributed operational outcomes and expose sample size and success rate.
acceptance_criteria: Lease completion updates the exact agent, domain and role specialization
Specialization remains emerging until the configured evidence threshold
The Interaction Board exposes provenance
falsification_tests: An agent becomes established without sufficient observed outcomes

body.objective: Prove one reproducible failure family that passes pointwise evaluation but fails longitudinal trajectory assurance.
acceptance_criteria: At least 30 paired control and treatment replications
Pointwise PASS and trajectory FAIL are both explicit
Treatment effect and confidence interval are reported as a vector of metrics
constraints: same seed set for control and treatment
single trajectory is never ground truth
falsification_tests: No materially relevant trajectory-only failure is reproduced

body.objective: Test explicit policy, memory, model or capability interventions through counterfactual replay and recovery measurement.
acceptance_criteria: Replay starts from a verified event prefix
Intervention fields and changed outcomes are recorded
Unsupported causality remains false
Correction persistence and recovery probability are measured
constraints: label temporal and causal edges separately
falsification_tests: Counterfactual replay silently rewrites history or claims unsupported causality

body.objective: Contain repeatedly falsified capabilities and demote contradicted beliefs until independent release evidence exists.
acceptance_criteria: Repeated causal falsification creates an execution hold
Contradicted beliefs are demoted with reason and evidence
Release requires WorldLab, OpenMythos and approval references
falsification_tests: A contained capability executes or a demoted belief is treated as trusted without release evidence

body.objective: Measure scarcity, provider monoculture, stale registry, containment and recovery in the synthetic read-only federation mirror.
acceptance_criteria: All inputs are synthetic or sanitized snapshots
Resource starvation, behavioral degradation, epistemic degradation, containment and recovery are reported separately
Protected DjimitFlo invariants never fail
constraints: do not start until goals 1 through 11 pass
falsification_tests: A synthetic chaos run gains operational authority or hides provider monoculture failure
